name: Wei
self_text: I am a Japanese person in my mid 20s with a background in biology. When I am not studying, I love swing dancing because the energy of the music and movement is exhilarating. Recently, I have been focusing on language practice and am looking for a way to integrate this into my routine. A typical session for me involves studying independently side by side, while talking things through as we go. I specifically value having someone to explain things to me during these periods. I am flexible regarding the venue and am happy to meet either in person or online. In terms of my schedule, I am available on Saturday morning, Saturday afternoon, or during weekday evenings.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into language practice. It would be nice if you are okay with occasional short exchanges or talking things through as we go, and a small bonus if you are the one who explains the material to me.
